opencalque-1.7.0.js is a browser build of OpenCalque's drawing engine (@opencalque/core,
@opencalque/ext-architecture, @opencalque/warehouse) from https://github.com/laurent512/opencalque
at commit 9bf3a24afef8b7e273d47b140221c6bfd3829777, bundled with its dependencies zod, clipper-lib and
fractional-indexing. SITREP uses it to read OpenCalque drawings and DXF files on the floor plan sheet.
